summary: Fix a latent bug (issue #380): a Strategy played from the hand stayed in the hand when its action returned early, skipping the tail that runs SpendHandPlayedCard. Your Clan Needs You! (oracle-l5r-9687) did it whenever the recruit opened a window (Proclaim, an entering-play Reaction, an Overconfident draw); Preserving Honor (oracle-l5r-6060, found by auditing every early return in RunAbilityEffects against every Strategy/Ring in CardCatalog) did it for every use, since the opponent's bow-or-move choice is its whole effect. Both now call SpendHandPlayedCard as the window/choice opens, the pattern At Any Cost (#373/#378, merged) and Unfortunate Hesitation use (a no-op for the tail once the card has left the hand). No other Strategy/Ring reaches an early return unspent. Engine change is 7 lines in src/L5R.Core/CardAbilities.cs plus a new regression suite tests/L5R.Core.Tests/HandPlayedStrategySpentTests.cs.
validation: New suite hand-played-strategy-spent (6 tests, through QueryActions: Proclaim window, entering-play Reaction window, Overconfident window, no-window control with exactly-one discard, no replay after the window closes with the per-turn use stamp cleared, Preserving Honor bow and move): 5 of 6 fail on unfixed origin/main 7d4bf332 for the reported reason (Strategy still in Hand; offered again once the stamp clears) and all 6 pass with the fix. Mutation-checked: dropping the Your Clan Needs You! spend fails 4 tests, dropping Preserving Honor's fails 1, moving the spend after the entry sequence fails the same 4 as dropping it, and removing SpendHandPlayedCard's still-in-hand guard fails the exactly-once control (plus 7 other existing tests). bash tools/check.sh --skip-client run twice, the second time after rebasing onto origin/main d33e6073 (#378 merged): exit 0, All requested checks passed (Python tools/collaboration 43 and tools/content 132; L5R.Core.Tests 216/216 including 59/59 published; L5R.AI.Tests 28/28; server integration 8/8; client transport 7/7). GitHub CI not yet observed; no native graphical playtest (engine-only change).
remaining: None for the two affected cards; ready for review. Observation, NOT investigated: an action that returns early also skips the rest of CompleteAbilityResolution's tail (e.g. the additional-action grant forfeiture that Unfortunate Hesitation redoes by hand, Ninja/Favor bookkeeping, NextAction); only the discard of the hand-played card is fixed here.
